title: Frontiers | A Comprehensive Review on the Therapeutic Potential of Curcuma longa Linn. in Relation to its Major Active Constituent Curcumin
abstract: longa* of India is particularly popular when compared with those from other countries due to its high curcumin concentration, which is the most essential and active biological ingredient responsible for its therapeutic potential (Verma et al., 2018). longa* and curcumin show antioxidant features close to vitamins C and E in both aqueous and fat-soluble extracts. longa* in relation to its major compound curcumin, we have attempted to provide in-depth information by highlighting knowledge gaps in traditional and scientific evidence about *C. longa* in relation to the therapeutic potential of curcumin against numerous disorders. Turmeric (Curcuma Longa) and its Major Constituent (Curcumin) as Nontoxic and Safe Substances: Review. Medicinal Properties of Turmeric (Curcuma Longa L.): A Review. Fuloria S, Mehta J, Chandel A, Sekar M, Rani NNIM, Begum MY, Subramaniyan V, Chidambaram K, Thangavelu L, Nordin R, Wu YS, Sathasivam KV, Lum PT, Meenakshi DU, Kumarasamy V, Azad AK and Fuloria NK (2022) A Comprehensive Review on the Therapeutic Potential of *Curcuma longa* Linn.
